data.title: RISEx Offers XLP Vault Attacker 20% of Stolen Funds If 80% Is Returned by September 23
data.description:
Decentralized exchange RISEx sent an on-chain message to the attacker behind the XLP vault incident after seeing funds begin to move. According to Foresight News, the team said the attacker could keep 20%, or about 134,566 USDC, if the remaining 80%, or about 538,265 USDC or equivalent ETH, is returned to its official Ethereum or Base address by September 23, and the case would be handled as a white-hat hack.

Foresight News previously reported that RISEx said on August 4 that an unauthorized withdrawal occurred in its XLP vault-related RWA strategy, affecting 673,011.56 USDC.

data.title: Anthropic Faces Privacy Risk Scrutiny Over Policy Revisions and Data Handling
data.description: Yuyuantantian said Silicon Valley is debating the pace and safety of AI development and reviewed 13 revisions to Anthropic's privacy policy since the company released its first version in 2023. According to Odaily, the review compared the policy changes with the ISO/IEC 27701 privacy information management standard and said Anthropic user privacy data security risks have increased. It also described three steps that it said turned Anthropic into an "intelligence center": transferring overseas user data to the United States, expanding the sources of user data, and providing intelligence to U.S. intelligence agencies in exchange for benefits.

data.title: Majid Al Futtaim CEO Sees Path to Doubling Equity Value Over 5 to 7 Years
data.description: According to CNBC, Majid Al Futtaim Group CEO Ahmed Galal Ismail said the retail and real estate group sees a path to doubling its equity value over the next five to seven years despite regional conflict. He also said the privately held company is pressing ahead with a nearly $30 billion development pipeline and plans to keep investing in technology and artificial intelligence, while expanding in Saudi Arabia, Egypt and East Africa.

data.title: Hong Kong Completes First HKD Stablecoin Digital Asset Investment Use Case
data.description:
China Asset Management (Hong Kong) said it has completed Hong Kong's first use case for investing in digital assets with the HKDAP Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, alongside Standard Chartered Bank and others. According to ChainCatcher, the case was presented as an example of how a regulated Hong Kong dollar stablecoin can work with digital financial assets under compliance and regulatory frameworks.

HKDAP is a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin issued by Anchorpoint Financial, a licensed stablecoin issuer in Hong Kong, and was established under the leadership of Standard Chartered Bank Hong Kong.

data.title: China Asset Management (Hong Kong) and Standard Chartered Complete Hong Kong's First HKDAP Digital Asset Investment Use Case
data.description: China Asset Management (Hong Kong) said it has completed Hong Kong's first use case for investing in digital assets with the Hong Kong dollar stablecoin HKDAP, together with Standard Chartered Bank and others. According to Odaily, the company said the case shows how a regulated Hong Kong dollar stablecoin can work with digital financial assets under compliance and regulatory frameworks to provide investors with more diversified investment options. HKDAP is a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin established by Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) and issued by licensed Hong Kong stablecoin issuer Anchorpoint Financial.

data.title: AI | China State TV Affiliate Flags Anthropic Privacy Risks
data.description:
A social-media account affiliated with China Central Television said Anthropic PBC’s privacy-policy revisions raise risks to user data by allowing information to be shared with US intelligence agencies when the company deems it necessary, without legal procedures, according to Bloomberg.

The post was published on Saturday.

data.title: Dtcpay Raises $25 Million in Series A Funding Led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India
data.description:
Singapore-based compliant stablecoin payments company Dtcpay said it has completed a $25 million Series A funding round led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India, with SBI participating through two Singapore investment entities. According to Odaily, Dtcpay provides services for accepting, storing, and trading stablecoins and fiat currencies.

The company said the funds will be used to expand its merchant network, build infrastructure, develop enterprise portal and consumer app features, and enter more regulated markets. Dtcpay has also integrated WalletConnect and launched a stablecoin-to-fiat card connected to Visa.

data.title: China's January-August Exports Rise 19% to $2.93 Trillion, Trade Surplus With U.S. Reaches $199.7 Billion
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Cui Dongshu of the CPCA said the General Administration of Customs released January-August 2026 import and export data showing China's goods trade exports rose 19% year on year to $2.9255 trillion, with August exports reaching a record $401.4 billion for the month. He also said China's trade surplus with the U.S. was $199.7 billion in January-August 2026, while the overall surplus remained in a good state.

data.title: Bolivia Ends Diesel Subsidy After IMF Approves $1.9 Billion Loan
data.description:
Bolivia’s government has eliminated its diesel subsidy after the Senate approved a $1.9 billion loan from the International Monetary Fund, according to Bloomberg.

The loan calls for spending curbs.

data.title: California Court Blocks Part of TikTok’s $400 Million Settlement
data.description:
A Los Angeles judge tentatively opposed part of the US government’s agreement with TikTok to settle allegations of children’s privacy violations, according to Bloomberg.

The ruling extends uncertainty around TikTok’s operations in the US.

data.title: Morgan Stanley Bitcoin ETF Buys $51.5 Million in Bitcoin Over 20 Trading Days
data.description: BlockBeats reported on September 19 that Arkham disclosed Morgan Stanley Bitcoin ETF (MSBT) bought about $51.5 million worth of Bitcoin over the past 20 trading days, with no single-day outflows during the period. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, MSBT is also one of the few Bitcoin funds this month that has not recorded a single day of net outflows.

data.title: Switchboard Announces It Will Cease Operations and End Oracle Support on September 25
data.description:
Multi-chain oracle project Switchboard said on X that it will stop operating. Its core development contributor, Switchboard Technology Labs, will gradually wind down the remaining business, and all Switchboard implementations will stop maintenance immediately before remaining support ends on September 25. According to Odaily, protocols using its oracle are being asked to migrate to alternatives such as Pyth and RedStone.

Switchboard said AI has lowered the cost of building oracles in-house, while the crypto bear market has reduced the number of new blockchains and project budgets. It also said direct data partnerships, such as those between Hyperliquid and S&P data providers, suggest protocols may increasingly obtain data directly, weakening the value of third-party oracle networks.

data.title: UK Prime Minister to Meet Trump to Seek Patriot Missile Release for Ukraine
data.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham is set to meet U.S. President Donald Trump next week during the United Nations General Assembly. According to Sina Finance, Burnham's main goal is to persuade Trump to release Patriot air-defense missile stockpiles for delivery to Ukraine before winter, while the two sides are also expected to discuss how Europe can ease disruptions in the Middle East.

data.title: Brazil's CVM Advances Distributed Ledger Pilot for Tokenized Securities
data.description:
Brazil's securities regulator, the CVM, is moving ahead with a distributed ledger technology pilot program for tokenized securities. According to Odaily, the 60-day test will involve simulated trading only, with no real securities or investors, and may be extended by 30 days pending board approval.

The pilot is coordinated by the CVM tokenization working group and covers the full securities lifecycle, including issuance and settlement, for stocks, bonds, receivables certificates, and investment fund units.

data.title: Brazil Securities Regulator Advances 60-Day DLT Pilot for Tokenized Securities
data.description:
Brazil's securities regulator, the CVM, is moving ahead with a distributed ledger technology pilot program for tokenized securities. According to ChainCatcher, the test will involve simulated transactions only and will not include real securities or investors.

The pilot is being coordinated by the CVM tokenization working group, or GTT, and is set to run for 60 days with a possible 30-day extension. The draft still requires board approval. The scope covers most of the securities lifecycle, including issuance through settlement for stocks, bonds, receivables certificates, and investment fund units.

data.title: Fincantieri Plans 600 Million Euro Underwater Expansion as Seabed Security Gains Focus
data.description: According to CNBC, Italian shipbuilder Fincantieri announced in July plans to acquire majority stakes in four companies for around 600 million euros ($689 million) as it expands into underwater and surface drones, marine surveying and subsea communications. The article said governments and defense companies are investing more heavily in technologies for underwater surveillance and seabed protection as concerns rise over the vulnerability of cables, pipelines and other critical infrastructure. Euroatlas said it has signed more than 100 million euros in GrayShark contracts with unnamed European navies, while TeleGeography said more than 1.5 million kilometers of submarine communications cables were in service globally as of early 2026.

data.title: Bitdeer Reports 287.2 BTC Mined and Sold in Week Ending September 18
data.description: Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin mining company Bitdeer said it produced 287.2 BTC in the week ending September 18 and sold the same amount during the period. According to Odaily, the company reported net additions of zero BTC and said it still holds no Bitcoin.

data.title: Bitdeer Reports 287.2 BTC Mined and Sold in Week Ending September 18
data.description: Bitdeer said its Bitcoin mining output totaled 287.2 BTC for the week ending September 18, while it sold 287.2 BTC during the same period. According to ChainCatcher, the Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin miner reported net additions of 0 BTC and said it still holds no Bitcoin.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Vitalik Buterin Says Local AI Is Nearing Private, High-Task Use on Strix Halo Laptop
data.description: Vitalik Buterin said local AI on his Strix Halo laptop is approaching a point where it can handle a large share of tasks while keeping personal context private. According to NS3.AI, a benchmark image showed input-processing rates of 109.82 to 373.22 tokens per second and output rates of 18.42 to 33.37 tokens per second across 10 workloads. The analysis added that wallet software still needs fixed policies, transaction assertions, and human approval before AI can control crypto assets.

data.title: Blackstone Says India Is Nearing a Turning Point for Foreign Capital
data.description: Blackstone Inc. sees India nearing a tipping point for foreign capital, according to Bloomberg. Jon Gray said the firm’s first move into India started slowly and then faced headwinds during the global financial crisis.
